name: Report Parameters 3
definition: Provides the parameters of the report.

ReportDateAndTime.name: Report Date And Time
ReportDateAndTime.definition: Date (and time) and time of the report.

ReportCurrency.name: Report Currency
ReportCurrency.definition: Currency used for the calculation of the margin.

CalculationDateAndTime.name: Calculation Date And Time
CalculationDateAndTime.definition: Date of calculation of the margin.

ReportNumberRule.definition: If the report has multiple pages, then the ReportNumber must remain the same through all the pages. It is a unique number to the report.|Two reports of the same type sent one after the other to the same receiver in relation to the same safekeeping account must have different ReportNumbers. For example, a daily report sent on day 1 would have ReportNumber 001, on day 2, 002, etc.
